title: Brief special meeting authorizes closed session
subtitle: Closed session to cover land, legal and negotiation matters; no other business, and the meeting adjourned quickly.
overview: Kitchener City Council held a short special meeting on December 15, 2025. The Mayor opened with a land acknowledgement, no one declared a pecuniary interest, and there were no mayoral updates.

The only substantive action was authorizing a closed session to follow the meeting. Council agreed {{vote:m1}} to meet privately on several matters allowed under the Municipal Act, 2001: solicitor-client privilege, potential land disposition, a position to be applied to negotiations, potential litigation, and a land acquisition.

For residents, the meeting made no decisions on those topics. The minutes report no outcomes from the closed session, and any later public decisions would come back through regular Council meetings. The meeting adjourned shortly after it began, with no public delegations or other items recorded in the minutes.

decisions.detail: Council authorized a closed session after the special meeting to consider solicitor-client privilege, land disposition, negotiation positions, potential litigation and land acquisition matters under Section 239 (2) of the Municipal Act, 2001.
